name: canary-ours
purpose: iter-467 canary lane: OUR side of the Xenia Canary side-by-side (tools/perf/canary_compare.py; docs/CANARY_COMPARISON.md). The natural retail front end, pressed exactly where the Xenia side presses: NOTHING until the guest requests the title (screens/bootflow/ScrPressStart; boot load time = launch -> that request, intro movies unskipped, as on Xenia), a 10 s title dwell (the title scene), START, the game's own LOAD A GAME? popup, A = START NEW GAME (Xenia: DOWN A = continue without a profile), then the route tape (SR_INPUT_REPLAY, anchored on the guest's main_hud request like tools/xenia_pad_tape.py on Xenia) for its length. No present dumps: a dump is a synchronous readback on the render thread and would land in the frame-time census. Run it through canary_compare.py, which sets the gates (SR_INPUT_REPLAY, SR_PERF_STATS, SR_HIGHFPS, SR_RES_SCALE, SR_WINDOW_SIZE, SR_AUDIO_SINK=null, SR_LOG=player, SR_MODS=0).

steps.name: title-dwell
steps.purpose: The title scene: PRESS START over the 3D city, measured on both sides.

steps.purpose: The natural LOAD A GAME? popup.

steps.name: route
steps.purpose: The route tape plays from the main_hud anchor (opening FMV, gameplay on foot, flight, the pause menu); canary_compare.py stops the roll after it.
